words.definition: A modular unit in a system or program that performs a specific function.
words.example_en: Each function block in the diagram controls a different part of the machine.
words.example_sk: Každý funkčný blok v diagrame ovláda inú časť stroja.

words.definition: A graphical programming language and schematic representation used in industrial automation and control systems, resembling a ladder with two vertical rails and horizontal rungs.
words.example_en: Each rung of the ladder represents a specific control operation, with inputs (contacts) on the left and outputs (coils) on the right.
words.example_sk: Každý priečka rebríka predstavuje špecifickú riadiacu operáciu, pričom vstupy (kontakty) sú vľavo a výstupy (cievky) vpravo.

words.definition: Variables that are declared outside of functions or blocks and can be accessed from many parts of a program.
words.example_en: Global variables can be accessed and changed anywhere inside the script.
words.example_sk: Globálne premenná sú prístupné a ich zmena je možná kdekoľvek v skripte.

words.definition: Reserved words or important terms in a programming language that have a specific meaning and function in code.
words.example_en: The engineer used language keywords like 'if', 'while', and 'return' when writing the control software for the robot.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil kľúčové slová jazyka ako „if“, „while“ a „return“ pri písaní riadiaceho softvéru pre robota.

words.definition: A method of representing real numbers in computing, where the decimal point can move to allow a wide range of values.
words.example_en: In general, calculations that involve floating point numbers take longer than calculations involving fixed point numbers.
words.example_sk: Vo všeobecnosti výpočty s číslami s pohyblivou desatinnou čiarkou trvajú dlhšie ako výpočty s číslami s pevnou desatinnou čiarkou.

words.definition: A data type used to store whole numbers without fractional parts.
words.example_en: In the control software, the sensor count is stored as an integer data type because it must be a whole number.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom softvéri je počet snímačov uložený ako celočíselný dátový typ, pretože musí byť celé číslo.

words.definition: A whole number data type that can store only non-negative values and usually has a larger range than a standard integer.
words.example_en: Unsigned long variables are extended size variables for number storage, and store 32 bits (4 bytes).
words.example_sk: Premenné typu Unsigned long sú premenné s rozšírenou veľkosťou na ukladanie čísel a ukladajú 32 bitov (4 bajty).

words.definition: A non-negative integer data type that uses twice the standard integer storage size to represent larger whole numbers.
words.example_en: The control software stores the sensor count in an unsigned double integer to avoid overflow in the engineering system.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci softvér ukladá počet snímačov do neznamienkového dvojitého celého čísla, aby sa v inžinierskom systéme zabránilo pretečeniu.

words.definition: A data type or value representation in computing and engineering systems that stores an integer using more bits or larger capacity than a standard integer.
words.example_en: In the control software, the sensor counter was stored as a double integer to prevent overflow during long test cycles.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom softvéri bol čítač snímača uložený ako dvojitý celočíselný typ, aby sa počas dlhých testovacích cyklov zabránilo pretečeniu.

words.definition: An integer data type that can store only zero and positive whole numbers, without negative values.
words.example_en: In embedded engineering, an unsigned integer is often used to store memory addresses and sensor values that cannot be negative.
words.example_sk: V embedded inžinierstve sa nezáporné celé číslo často používa na ukladanie adries pamäte a hodnôt zo senzorov, ktoré nemôžu byť záporné.

words.definition: Categories of data that define what kind of value a variable can store and how it can be used in a system or program.
words.example_en: When designing the control software, the engineer selected the correct data types for sensor readings and system status values.
words.example_sk: Pri navrhovaní riadiaceho softvéru inžinier vybral správne dátové typy pre hodnoty zo senzorov a stavové hodnoty systému.

words.definition: Variables defined outside a function, module, or local scope that can be accessed from other parts of a program or system.
words.example_en: In the control software for the robotic assembly line, external variables store sensor values that multiple modules need to access.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom softvéri pre robotickú montážnu linku externé premenné ukladajú hodnoty zo senzorov, ku ktorým potrebuje pristupovať viacero modulov.

words.definition: Words in a programming or technical language that have a fixed meaning and cannot be used freely as names for variables, functions, or other identifiers.
words.example_en: When writing control software for the robot, the engineer avoided using reserved keywords as variable names in the code.
words.example_sk: Pri písaní riadiaceho softvéru pre robota sa inžinier vyhol používaniu rezervovaných kľúčových slov ako názvov premenných v kóde.

words.definition: Data that is listed or organized as numbered items for clear reference and analysis.
words.example_en: The engineering report presented enumerated data to compare the performance of each prototype.
words.example_sk: Inžinierska správa uvádzala číslované údaje na porovnanie výkonu každého prototypu.

words.definition: A simplified graphical representation of a system, showing its main parts as blocks and the connections between them.
words.example_en: The engineer used a block diagram to explain how the control system processes input signals.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil blokovú schému na vysvetlenie, ako riadiaci systém spracúva vstupné signály.

words.definition: A set of step-by-step rules or instructions used to solve a problem or perform a calculation.
words.example_en: The simplest example of an algorithm is a recipe or procedure for making tea.
words.example_sk: Najednoduchším príkladom algoritmu je aj recept alebo postup pomocou, ktorého si varíme čaj.

words.definition: Values or symbols used inside a system, model, or program to store and represent data during engineering calculations or operations.
words.example_en: The control algorithm uses internal variables to monitor pressure and temperature in the system.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci algoritmus používa interné premenné na sledovanie tlaku a teploty v systéme.

words.definition: A particular example or occurrence of something; in engineering and computing, a specific occurrence of a component, process, or object.
words.example_en: In this software engineering model, each sensor is represented as a separate instance of the same class.
words.example_sk: V tomto modeli softvérového inžinierstva je každý senzor reprezentovaný ako samostatná inštancia tej istej triedy.

words.definition: A scheduling method in which a running task or process can be interrupted and replaced by another task, usually to improve responsiveness or meet priority requirements.
words.example_en: In real-time engineering systems, preemptive scheduling allows a high-priority control task to interrupt a lower-priority process.
words.example_sk: V inžinierskych systémoch reálneho času preemptívne plánovanie umožňuje, aby úloha s vysokou prioritou prerušila proces s nižšou prioritou.

words.definition: A scheduling method in which a task or process runs until it finishes or voluntarily yields control, without being interrupted by another task.
words.example_en: In embedded systems engineering, non-preemptive scheduling can simplify timing analysis because each task runs to completion once it starts.
words.example_sk: V inžinierstve vstavaných systémov môže nepreemptívne plánovanie zjednodušiť časovú analýzu, pretože každá úloha po spustení beží až do dokončenia.

words.definition: A repeated step or cycle in a process, often used to improve a design, model, or calculation.
words.example_en: After each iteration of the prototype, the engineering team fixed several design problems.
words.example_sk: Po každej iterácii prototypu inžiniersky tím opravil niekoľko problémov v návrhu.

words.definition: Written or spoken expressions that present information, facts, or positions, often in reports, specifications, or technical communication.
words.example_en: The engineer reviewed the safety statements in the project documentation before approving the design.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval bezpečnostné vyhlásenia v projektovej dokumentácii pred schválením návrhu.

words.definition: Programming statements that repeat a block of code while a condition is true or for a specified number of times.
words.example_en: In control engineering software, iteration statements are used to process sensor data repeatedly inside the monitoring loop.
words.example_sk: V softvéri pre riadiace inžinierstvo sa iteračné príkazy používajú na opakované spracovanie údajov zo senzorov v monitorovacej slučke.

words.definition: People who control, use, or monitor machines, systems, or equipment.
words.example_en: The machine operators checked the control panel before starting the production line.
words.example_sk: Operátori strojov skontrolovali ovládací panel pred spustením výrobnej linky.

words.definition: The process of examining two or more things to identify similarities and differences.
words.example_en: The engineer made a comparison of the two bridge designs before choosing the safer option.
words.example_sk: Inžinier urobil porovnanie dvoch návrhov mosta pred výberom bezpečnejšej možnosti.

words.definition: The state of being equal, especially in value, status, or quantity.
words.example_en: In engineering calculations, the equality of the two expressions confirms that the design formula is correct.
words.example_sk: V inžinierskych výpočtoch rovnosť dvoch výrazov potvrdzuje, že návrhový vzorec je správny.

words.definition: A mathematical statement showing that two values or expressions are not equal, often using symbols such as <, >, ≤, or ≥.
words.example_en: In control engineering, the stability condition can be written as an inequality involving the system parameters.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom inžinierstve možno podmienku stability zapísať ako nerovnosť obsahujúcu parametre systému.

words.definition: Relating to a system of logic or a data type that has only two possible values, typically true and false.
words.example_en: The control algorithm uses a boolean variable to switch the motor on or off.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci algoritmus používa booleovskú premennú na zapnutie alebo vypnutie motora.

words.definition: The mathematical operation of taking one number or quantity away from another.
words.example_en: In engineering calculations, subtraction is used to find the difference between two measurements.
words.example_sk: Pri inžinierskych výpočtoch sa odčítanie používa na zistenie rozdielu medzi dvoma meraniami.

words.definition: A logical operation that is true when exactly one of two inputs is true, but false when both are true or both are false.
words.example_en: In digital engineering, the exclusive OR gate outputs a high signal only when the two input values are different.
words.example_sk: V digitálnom inžinierstve hradlo výlučné ALEBO vydáva vysoký signál iba vtedy, keď sú dve vstupné hodnoty odlišné.

words.definition: A conjunction used to connect alternatives or choices.
words.example_en: The engineer can use steel or aluminum for the frame.
words.example_sk: Inžinier môže na rám použiť oceľ alebo hliník.

words.definition: A formal or clear expression of information, opinion, or facts, often used in reports, specifications, or technical communication.
words.example_en: The engineer included a statement in the report confirming that the structure met the safety requirements.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zahrnul do správy vyhlásenie, že konštrukcia spĺňa bezpečnostné požiadavky.

words.definition: A value that is set in advance and used as a default or fixed parameter in a system or process.
words.example_en: The engineer entered the preset value into the control system before starting the machine.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zadal prednastavenú hodnotu do riadiaceho systému pred spustením stroja.

words.definition: Computer-based systems used to monitor, control, and automate industrial processes and machinery.
words.example_en: Industrial control systems regulate temperature, pressure, and flow in modern engineering plants.
words.example_sk: Priemyselné riadiace systémy regulujú teplotu, tlak a prietok v moderných inžinierskych závodoch.

words.definition: Information or responses about the performance or result of a process, system, or design, used for improvement or control.
words.example_en: The engineering team used sensor feedback to improve the stability of the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil spätnú väzbu zo senzorov na zlepšenie stability riadiaceho systému.

words.definition: The process of judging or measuring the quality, value, or performance of something.
words.example_en: The engineering team completed the evaluation of the new bridge design before construction began.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím dokončil hodnotenie nového návrhu mosta pred začiatkom výstavby.

words.definition: The practical ways in which a plan, design, algorithm, or system is put into effect.
words.example_en: The engineering team compared several implementations of the control algorithm before selecting the most efficient one.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím porovnal niekoľko implementácií riadiaceho algoritmu pred výberom najefektívnejšej.

words.definition: The management of when, how, and under what conditions a function is executed within a system or program.
words.example_en: In embedded engineering, function execution control is essential to ensure that safety-critical tasks run at the correct time.
words.example_sk: V embedded inžinierstve je riadenie vykonávania funkcií nevyhnutné na to, aby sa úlohy kritické z hľadiska bezpečnosti vykonávali v správnom čase.

words.definition: A device or circuit that compares two values, such as voltages or dimensions, and indicates which one is greater or whether they are equal.
words.example_en: The engineer used a comparator circuit to detect when the sensor voltage exceeded the reference level.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil komparátorový obvod na zistenie, kedy napätie zo snímača prekročilo referenčnú úroveň.

words.definition: Graphical programming diagrams used in industrial control and automation to represent logic similar to electrical relay circuits.
words.example_en: The automation engineer used ladder diagrams to program the PLC for the conveyor system.
words.example_sk: Automatizačný inžinier použil rebríkové diagramy na naprogramovanie PLC pre dopravníkový systém.

words.definition: Technical drawings that use standardized symbols to show the components and connections in an electrical circuit.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the electrical circuit diagrams before assembling the control panel.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval elektrické schémy obvodov pred zostavením ovládacieho panela.

words.definition: Fits or connects securely with another part by overlapping or engaging with it; also refers to mechanisms that prevent unsafe operation unless certain conditions are met.
words.example_en: The steel panels interlocks are designed to keep the machine guard closed during operation.
words.example_sk: Vzájomné blokovania oceľových panelov sú navrhnuté tak, aby počas prevádzky udržiavali ochranný kryt stroja zatvorený.

words.definition: Graphical signs used in engineering diagrams to represent a coil, inductor, or winding in electrical circuits.
words.example_en: The technician checked the coil symbols on the schematic before wiring the transformer.
words.example_sk: Technik skontroloval symboly cievky na schéme pred zapojením transformátora.

words.definition: Loops of wire, tubing, or other material wound into a circular or spiral shape, often used in electrical and mechanical systems.
words.example_en: The engineer tested the coils in the motor to check for overheating.
words.example_sk: Inžinier testoval cievky v motore, aby skontroloval prehrievanie.

words.definition: Closed, fastened, or secured with a latch so that it stays in place.
words.example_en: Before starting the test, the engineer checked that the access panel was fully latched.
words.example_sk: Pred spustením testu inžinier skontroloval, či bol prístupový panel úplne zaistený.

words.definition: A button that is operated by pressing it to control a machine or electrical circuit.
words.example_en: The engineer pressed the pushbutton to start the conveyor system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier stlačil tlačidlo, aby spustil dopravníkový systém.

words.definition: Not limited to two logical states such as true/false or 0/1; not based on Boolean logic.
words.example_en: The control algorithm uses non-Boolean variables to represent multiple machine states in the engineering model.
words.example_sk: Riadiaci algoritmus používa nebooleovské premenné na reprezentáciu viacerých stavov stroja v inžinierskom modeli.

words.definition: A name, code, or symbol used to identify a label in a system, drawing, or engineering process.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the label identifier on the control panel to match the wiring diagram.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval identifikátor štítku na ovládacom paneli, aby zodpovedal schéme zapojenia.

words.definition: Function Block Diagram networks used to connect and organize function blocks in control and automation engineering.
words.example_en: The engineer used FBD networks to design the logic for the automated production line.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil siete FBD na návrh logiky pre automatizovanú výrobnú linku.

words.definition: A formal system in mathematical logic and computer engineering that builds computations from function combinators without using variables.
words.example_en: In theoretical computer engineering, combinatory logic is used to model computation without variables.
words.example_sk: V teoretickom počítačovom inžinierstve sa kombinatorická logika používa na modelovanie výpočtov bez premenných.

words.definition: Symbols or expressions used in programming and engineering logic to perform different actions depending on whether a condition is true or false.
words.example_en: In the control software, conditional operators determine how the system responds when a sensor value exceeds the safety limit.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom softvéri podmienené operátory určujú, ako systém reaguje, keď hodnota senzora prekročí bezpečnostný limit.

words.definition: Commonly used symbols or functions in engineering and technical systems that perform basic operations such as addition, subtraction, comparison, or control.
words.example_en: In the control system design, standard operators are used to define how input signals are processed.
words.example_sk: Pri návrhu riadiaceho systému sa štandardní operátori používajú na určenie toho, ako sa spracúvajú vstupné signály.

words.definition: A machine-oriented command that is close to the hardware and uses little abstraction from the processor's operations.
words.example_en: The embedded systems engineer optimized the firmware by rewriting a low-level instruction for the microcontroller.
words.example_sk: Inžinier embedded systémov optimalizoval firmvér prepísaním nízkoúrovňovej inštrukcie pre mikrokontrolér.

words.definition: A low-level programming language that uses mnemonic instructions to represent machine code for a specific processor architecture.
words.example_en: The firmware engineer wrote part of the motor controller in assembler language to optimize timing on the embedded system.
words.example_sk: Firmvérový inžinier napísal časť riadenia motora v asemblerovom jazyku, aby optimalizoval časovanie v zabudovanom systéme.

words.definition: A person who controls or uses a machine, system, or piece of equipment.
words.example_en: The crane operator checked the control panel before lifting the steel beam.
words.example_sk: Operátor žeriava skontroloval ovládací panel pred zdvihnutím oceľového nosníka.

words.definition: A value, variable, or expression on which an operation is performed in a calculation or instruction.
words.example_en: In the control algorithm, the processor multiplies each operand by a calibration factor before sending the result to the actuator.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom algoritme procesor vynásobí každý operand kalibračným faktorom pred odoslaním výsledku do akčného člena.

words.definition: An instruction in programming or computer engineering that causes execution to continue at another specified point without checking any condition.
words.example_en: In the assembly routine, the unconditional jump transfers control directly to the error-handling block.
words.example_sk: V rutinnej časti assemblera nepodmienený skok presunie riadenie priamo do bloku na spracovanie chýb.

words.definition: An instruction in a program or control system that causes execution to move to a different point instead of continuing in sequence.
words.example_en: The engineer used a jump instruction in the PLC program to skip the initialization block after the sensor check.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil v programe PLC skokový príkaz, aby po kontrole snímača preskočil inicializačný blok.

words.definition: The mathematical process of calculating the product of two or more numbers or quantities.
words.example_en: In engineering calculations, multiplication is used to determine the total load on the beam.
words.example_sk: Pri inžinierskych výpočtoch sa násobenie používa na určenie celkového zaťaženia nosníka.

words.definition: The mathematical process of calculating how many times one number is contained in another.
words.example_en: In engineering calculations, division is used to determine the load per support.
words.example_sk: V inžinierskych výpočtoch sa delenie používa na určenie zaťaženia na jednu podporu.

words.definition: The act of making a statement, condition, or signal negative, or the denial of something.
words.example_en: In digital engineering, logical negation inverts the input signal so that a high voltage becomes a low output.
words.example_sk: V digitálnom inžinierstve logická negácia invertuje vstupný signál, takže vysoké napätie sa zmení na nízky výstup.

words.definition: An operation that gives the remainder after one number is divided by another.
words.example_en: In the control algorithm, the engineer used the modulo operator to keep the rotating sensor angle within a 360-degree range.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom algoritme inžinier použil operátor modulo na udržanie uhla otočného snímača v rozsahu 360 stupňov.

words.definition: The process of adding something, or the mathematical operation of combining quantities.
words.example_en: In circuit design, the addition of a resistor changed the total resistance of the system.
words.example_sk: Pri návrhu obvodu pridanie rezistora zmenilo celkový odpor systému.

words.definition: A device or function that measures or controls a period of time.
words.example_en: The engineer set the timer to control the testing cycle of the machine.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nastavil časovač na riadenie testovacieho cyklu stroja.

words.definition: A device or circuit that generates, measures, or controls pulses at specific time intervals.
words.example_en: The engineer configured the pulse timer to trigger the control signal every 50 milliseconds in the automation system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nastavil pulzný časovač tak, aby v automatizačnom systéme spúšťal riadiaci signál každých 50 milisekúnd.

words.definition: A digital counter that increases its count by one for each input pulse or clock signal.
words.example_en: The up-counter increments every time the sensor sends a pulse in the control circuit.
words.example_sk: Čítač nahor sa zvýši vždy, keď snímač vyšle impulz v riadiacom obvode.

words.definition: A digital counter that decreases its count by one with each input pulse or clock signal.
words.example_en: The engineer used a down-counter in the control circuit to track the remaining number of machine cycles.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil v riadiacom obvode zostupný čítač na sledovanie zostávajúceho počtu cyklov stroja.

words.definition: A circuit or logic component that detects when a digital signal changes from a high level to a low level.
words.example_en: The engineer used a falling edge detector to trigger the flip-flop when the clock signal changed from high to low.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil detektor zostupnej hrany na spustenie klopného obvodu, keď sa hodinový signál zmenil z vysokej úrovne na nízku.

words.definition: A circuit or device that detects the moment when a signal changes from low to high.
words.example_en: The rising edge detector triggers the flip-flop when the clock signal changes from 0 to 1.
words.example_sk: Detektor nábežnej hrany spustí klopný obvod, keď sa hodinový signál zmení z 0 na 1.

words.definition: Having two stable states and able to switch between them.
words.example_en: The terms Bistable, Latch and Flip-Flop are sometimes used interchangeably to describe Bistable circuits.
words.example_sk: Na opis bistabilných obvodov sa niekedy používajú zameniteľné pojmy bistabilný, západkový a preklopný obvod.

words.definition: A circuit or logic function that detects the transition of a signal from a high level to a low level.
words.example_en: The engineer used a falling edge detector to trigger the flip-flop when the clock signal changed from high to low.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil detektor zostupnej hrany na spustenie klopného obvodu, keď sa hodinový signál zmenil z vysokej úrovne na nízku.

words.definition: Calling or executing predefined functions in a program or system to perform specific tasks.
words.example_en: In control software engineering, invoking functions allows the system to process sensor data and update the actuator response.
words.example_sk: V softvérovom inžinierstve riadiacich systémov volanie funkcií umožňuje systému spracovať údaje zo senzorov a aktualizovať odozvu akčných členov.

words.definition: Words, symbols, or components that change, limit, or adjust the meaning, function, or performance of something else.
words.example_en: In the engineering specification, the modifiers changed the tolerance values for several machine parts.
words.example_sk: V technickej špecifikácii modifikátory zmenili hodnoty tolerancií pre niekoľko častí stroja.

words.definition: A function or operation that processes inputs, steps, or events in a specific fixed order, often with each stage depending on the previous one.
words.example_en: In the control system design, the sequential function activates each actuator in the required order to complete the assembly process safely.
words.example_sk: Pri návrhu riadiaceho systému sekvenčná funkcia aktivuje každý akčný člen v požadovanom poradí, aby sa montážny proces dokončil bezpečne.

words.definition: Sections in a control system or engineering diagram that perform a specific operation or process.
words.example_en: In the automation design, the action blocks control how the machine responds to sensor input.
words.example_sk: V návrhu automatizácie akčné bloky riadia, ako stroj reaguje na vstup zo snímačov.

words.definition: Variables that are linked or related to each other in a system, model, or engineering analysis.
words.example_en: In the control system model, engineers identified the associated variables that affect pressure and flow rate.
words.example_sk: V modeli riadiaceho systému inžinieri identifikovali súvisiace premenné, ktoré ovplyvňujú tlak a prietok.

words.definition: A change or shift that happens after an earlier stage, process, or condition.
words.example_en: In the control system design, the subsequent transition between operating modes must be smooth to avoid mechanical stress.
words.example_sk: Pri návrhu riadiaceho systému musí byť následný prechod medzi prevádzkovými režimami plynulý, aby sa predišlo mechanickému namáhaniu.

words.definition: Graphs that show how signals or events change over time in an electronic or digital system.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the timing diagrams to verify that the control signals were synchronized correctly.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval časové diagramy, aby overil, že riadiace signály boli správne synchronizované.

words.definition: A diagram that shows the sequence of steps, decisions, or operations in a process or system.
words.example_en: The engineering team used a flow chart to map each stage of the manufacturing process.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil vývojový diagram na zmapovanie každej fázy výrobného procesu.

words.definition: Detailed additional directions or requirements provided to guide a technical or engineering task.
